name: Open4DGS (open 4D Gaussian splatting pipeline for volumetric video)
summary: Arizona State University NEM pipeline that turns synchronized multi-camera video into 4D Gaussian splat reconstructions (TRiGS), with learned per-camera sub-frame timing offsets and a real-time viewer. Core tools MIT, trainer AGPL-3.0; example 27- and 45-camera captures on Hugging Face.

publisher.name: ASU Narrative and Emerging Media Labs

access.notes: Trainer is AGPL-3.0. Example datasets: private noncommercial evaluation only, HF sign-in + terms required. Initial research release; end-to-end GPU run on split repos not yet completed per README.

procedure: Optionally request the HF dataset asu-nem-labs/open4dgs-datasets

verdict.why: Rare open production-oriented 4DGS pipeline, but mixed MIT/AGPL licensing, noncommercial datasets and an unvalidated end-to-end run.

image.alt: Tools for preparing synchronized multi-camera captures, initializing dynamic Gaussian scenes, and exporting 4D reconstructions. Companion to Open4DGS-Trigs. - ASU-NEM-Labs/open4dgs-core
